detaileddescription.para: Minimal BSD-like socket abstraction for TCP client connections. Higher-level modules (HTTP client, MQTT, OTA) use this interface without knowing the underlying TCP/IP stack.

lwIP (raw or socket mode)
ESP-IDF (POSIX sockets via lwIP)
POSIX (Linux/macOS for development)
